questions.definition: A **perfume** is a scented liquid or lotion used to give a pleasant smell.
options: a liquid used to clean teeth
an oily substance applied to skin for warmth
a fragrant substance applied to the body

questions.definition: When someone **persevere**, they continue trying to do something even though it is difficult.
options: give up completely after one attempt

questions.definition: A **solicitor** is a legal professional who advises clients on legal matters and helps them with paperwork.
options: a person who writes legal documents but does not give advice
a judge who presides over court cases
a lawyer who focuses on representing clients in court

questions.definition: The **suburb** is an area on the outskirts of a town or city, usually with its own local facilities.
options: the central business district of a city
a residential area within a town

questions.definition: If someone is **accommodating**, they are willing to help others by changing their plans or behaviour to suit them.
